# AV Interior Decoration

> Interior and exterior design, fabrication and fitting team based in Thoothukudi (Tuticorin), Tamil Nadu. Over 10+ years on site and 500+ residential and commercial projects across Tamil Nadu.

## Business details

- Service Areas: Thoothukudi, Tuticorin, Tiruchendur, Kovilpatti, Tirunelveli, Nagercoil, Madurai, Tamil Nadu
- Quotation Policy: Free site visit, on-site measurement, material samples and itemised quote separating material and labour.

## Services
- [Modular Kitchens & Cupboards](https://avinteriordecoration.com/services/modular-kitchens): Kitchens, wardrobes, TV units and storage in PVC, MDF, plywood or aluminium. Options: Modular kitchen, TV showcase, UPVC cupboard, Aluminium cupboard, PVC cupboard, Plywood cupboard, MDF cupboard.
- [False Ceiling](https://avinteriordecoration.com/services/false-ceiling): Gypsum, grid, PVC and thermocol ceilings with lighting planned in. Options: Gypsum ceiling, Grid ceiling, PVC ceiling, Thermocol ceiling.
- [Blinds & Curtains](https://avinteriordecoration.com/services/blinds-and-curtains): Roller, zebra, roman, venetian and bamboo blinds, plus made-to-measure curtains. Options: Roller blinds, Zebra blinds, Roman blinds, PVC blinds, Wooden blinds, Curtains, Venetian blinds, Bamboo blinds.
- [UPVC Windows & Doors](https://avinteriordecoration.com/services/upvc-windows-and-doors): Sliding, openable and fixed UPVC windows and doors that seal out salt air and rain. Options: UPVC openable window, UPVC sliding window, Fixed window, UPVC partition.
- [Aluminium Works](https://avinteriordecoration.com/services/aluminium-works): Partitions, windows and fabrication in powder-coated aluminium. Options: Aluminium partition, Glass partition, Powder-coated partition, Sliding windows, Open windows.
- [Glass Partitions & Railings](https://avinteriordecoration.com/services/glass-partitions-and-railings): Toughened glass partitions, balcony railings and staircase railing systems. Options: 12 mm glass partition, Toughened glass partition, Aluminium balcony railing, Stainless steel railing, Staircase glass railing.
- [Flooring](https://avinteriordecoration.com/services/flooring): Vinyl, wooden and carpet flooring laid over properly prepared subfloors. Options: Vinyl flooring, Wooden flooring, Carpet.
- [Mosquito Nets](https://avinteriordecoration.com/services/mosquito-nets): Pleated, honeycomb, magnetic and retractable nets for windows and doors. Options: Open window net, Sliding pleated net, Honeycomb net, Magnetic door net, Fibre sliding pleated.
